messages:
sam_sales: Quick thread — Brightline renewal call just finished. They pushed hard to re-baseline to an older rate card and are asking for a 15% uplift discount + shorter term (6mo). Need guidance before I send a draft.
jordan_ae: Can you share current commit vs actuals and the ask in $ terms?
emily_csm: FYI usage last 12mo avg = 72 GPU-hours/day; current commit tier = 40. Health ok, retention signals positive, but their CFO is laser on unit cost.
maria_finance: 15% is outside our standard renewal band for mid-market. Typical is 5–10% depending on growth and commits. Need projected ARR impact and renewal term to run counter-offer. Deal Desk required for >10% discount or non-standard payment terms.
sam_sales: Baseline ARR = $360k. Their requested proposal pushes projected ARR to ~$390k after discounts. They explicitly requested 30% off published hosted list initially.
alex_revops: Do not promise >10% without Deal Desk. Options we can present: (A) 12mo term with 10% renewal discount + usage uplift cap; (B) 6mo at smaller discount + an ROI checkpoint at month 3; (C) short-term Dedicated pilot with committed minimum to lock price.
jordan_ae: Paste of what I sketched in the call for us to iterate on:
```
Proposal sketch for Brightline:
- Term: 12 months (preferred)
- Commit: $360,000
- Renewal discount: 10% off current rate card
- Uplift cap: 12% YoY
- Add-on: flex burst overage at published list
- ROI checkpoint: month 3 performance review; metrics: latency, token cost, SLA adherence
```
emily_csm: Customer will accept 12mo if we add the ROI checkpoint + an option to switch to a monthly overage if usage drops. They want a softer exit.
maria_finance: I'll create a formal Deal Desk package. Need: final ARR, proposed discount %, explicit special terms (data residency EU, SLA levels, ROI checkpoint language), and a clear reason code (renewal uplift negotiation).
sam_sales: @maria_finance adding EU data residency + 99.9% SLA request. Can you confirm turnaround?
maria_finance: 48–72h after submission. If discount request >15% we escalate to VP Sales and Legal.
legal: Note — any carveouts for termination or exit windows need SOW language. If we include ROI checkpoint, define pass/fail criteria and remediation steps. Also, data residency changes may trigger clause updates.
finance_bot: Deal Desk request created: DD-20240578 by maria_finance — status: pending — https://redwood.internal/deals/DD-20240578
sam_sales: I'll draft the customer-facing renewal with the 10% sketch + ROI checkpoint and share here. If Deal Desk greenlights >10% we re-open with list of concessions. :thumbsup:
jordan_ae: Thanks — I'll join the next call to present the ROI checkpoint details.
emily_csm: I'll prep the usage report and ROI template for month 3.
sam_sales: Will update once I have customer feedback.
